scope: One scripted session in a virtual machine; a demonstration, not boot verification and not a physical-hardware test.
captions: Postern OS 0.3.0-dev desktop live image booting offline in a virtual machine (software emulation; shown at 3x speed)
The desktop image starts GNOME on Wayland with automatic local login
Activities overview: Firefox, Files, Terminal, KeePassXC, Postern Status, Settings
Postern Status: the privacy baseline, one click from the dock
Terminal: release record of the running image
Create sample files to process (64 MiB of random data)
postern-data: hash every file in parallel into a private manifest
Verify the files against the saved manifest
Change one file: verification detects the modification
No SSH, discovery or remote-desktop service; firewall and AppArmor active
Swap is compressed memory only; nothing listens for remote login
Firefox: telemetry, studies and saved logins are disabled by locked policy
Firefox privacy settings: strict tracking protection, HTTPS-only mode
Files: removable media is never mounted or opened automatically
Settings: location services and usage reporting are off by default
All windows in the Activities overview
Power off: the live session leaves nothing on the machine's disks

checks.name: GNOME Wayland session is active
checks.command: ok=1; for attempt in $(seq 1 150); do for id in $(loginctl list-sessions --no-legend | awk '{print $1}'); do if test "$(loginctl show-session $id -p Name --value)" = nixos && test "$(loginctl show-session $id -p Type --value)" = wayland; then ok=0; fi; done; test $ok = 0 && break; sleep 2; done; test $ok = 0

checks.name: 'Press any key to close' is running
status report has no failed check
location services disabled
checks.command: export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u) DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/$(id -u)/bus; test "$(gsettings get org.gnome.system.location enabled)" = false

checks.name: no remote-desktop or SSH service
checks.command: ! systemctl is-active --quiet sshd.service && ! systemctl is-active --quiet gnome-remote-desktop.service
